content: The mind is a wild monkey dancing on the branches of desire; tie it with the rope of conscious breath.
author: Kabir
explanation: The untrained mind leaps restlessly from one craving to the next, scattering your life-force. Anchoring awareness to the steady rhythm of the breath restrains the wandering monkey.
practicalInsight: Whenever your mind starts racing today, take ten slow, deep diaphragmatic breaths, tracking every millimeter of the air.
reflectionPrompt: Is my mind dragging me through frantic desires, or am I tethering it to peaceful breath?
